summary: MainStreet Bancshares announced a new $10.0 million stock repurchase program via Form 8-K (Item 8.01). The program replaces a prior plan from October 2025. Purchases may be made on the open market or in private transactions at management's discretion, subject to market conditions and legal requirements. No specific price, premium, or timeline was disclosed. The board authorized but did not mandate any repurchases, and the program may be suspended or modified at any time. No advisor was named. What to watch: actual execution pace versus prior program, and any impact on share float.
